warnings: KEGG hsa04115 encodes 'BBC3 -expression-> TP53', but TP53 drives expression of 36 other genes on this map. This is probably an inversion in KEGG's own KGML file (the parser reproduces it faithfully). Drawn as KEGG encodes it and marked 'direction suspect'. Check the direction against Reactome or the literature before using it.
KEGG hsa04115 also encodes 'BBC3 -expression-> TP53AIP1' from the same suspect source; it is probably 'TP53 -> TP53AIP1'. Marked 'direction suspect'.
notes: No directed KEGG route for: BAX -> BBC3; BAX -> CASP3; BAX -> PMAIP1; BAX -> TP53; CASP3 -> BAX; CASP3 -> BBC3; CASP3 -> PMAIP1; CASP3 -> TP53; PMAIP1 -> BAX; PMAIP1 -> BBC3. This reflects the map's drawing, not proof that no regulation exists.
KEGG hsa04115 contains 66 reconstructable relations; 10 are kept for this question.
diagram_note: Directed relations redrawn from the KEGG map (KGML). Arrow = activation, x = inhibition, dashed = expression/indirect. Multi-gene boxes are paralog groups that KEGG draws as one node.
